features.quote: Step Limit: strictly capped at 8 turns. If the model enters a spiral, it typically begins by turn 3 or 4. Running past 8 turns wastes compute.
Do not truncate the agent's Thought history during the run. The model needs to see its own past apologies in the context window to fall into the auto-regressive trap
features.justification_quote: The model needs to see its own past apologies in the context window to fall into the auto-regressive trap that causes the repetitive spiral.
